model_scope.coefficient_unit: km3 gross irrigation diversion per 1000 km2 per year

classification.national_irrigation_withdrawal: benchmark only; not used to scale coefficients
classification.irrigated_rice_activity: endogenous; no target, share, minimum, or equality is added

gaez_v4.title: Global Agro-Ecological Zones version 4 Model Documentation
gaez_v4.use: The inherited CWD/WDe raster is ETm minus ETa, retained as the crop-climate deficit component rather than treated as total paddy duty.

fao_paddy_scheduling.title: Irrigation water management: Irrigation scheduling, Chapter 4
fao_paddy_scheduling.use: Rice net irrigation is ETcrop plus saturation plus percolation plus water layer minus effective precipitation.

fao_scheme_water_need.title: Scheme Irrigation Water Need and Supply

exact_inputs.gross_relation: gross irrigation requirement = net irrigation requirement / scheme efficiency

fao_rice_water_productivity.title: Rice and water: a long and diversified story
fao_rice_water_productivity.use: Independent engineering-range check, not a national-total calibration target.

nia_design_duty.title: NIA Memorandum Circular No. 125 s. 2025: Updated Design Criteria for Irrigation Canal Structures

psa_ssaf_2022.title: Selected Statistics on Agriculture and Fisheries 2022

engineering_assumptions.rationale: A conservative clay, well-puddled paddy lower engineering case is used uniformly because cluster soil and scheme-loss observations are not available.

calculations.cropping_intensity: irrigated palay harvested area / irrigation service area
calculations.annual_gross_iar: (GAEZ WDe metres per crop + 0.450 metres paddy additions per crop) * crops per year / 0.38
calculations.volume_conversion: 1 metre over 1000 km2 = 1 km3; equivalently coefficient * 10000 = m3/ha/year

limitations: The 38 percent efficiency is national rather than cluster- and scheme-specific.
The 2 mm/day percolation value represents a conservative heavy, well-puddled clay design case; cluster soil observations should replace it when available.
The annualization holds 2020 national cropping intensity constant through 2053.

The existing model does not separately route recoverable paddy seepage, drainage, or conveyance return flows; this repair corrects gross withdrawal coefficients without adding structural water-return commodities.
